questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “transient”:
questions.why: Transient = lasting only a short time. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Complete the sentence: “Under no circumstances ____ the ward after 9 p.m.”
questions.why: A negative phrase in front position requires modal + subject. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, “Do not make noise.”
opts: The teacher said the students do not make noise.
The teacher told the students do not make noise.
The teacher told the students to not made noise.
The teacher told the students not to make noise.
questions.why: A negative command is reported with 'told ... not to + verb'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “to let the cat out of the bag”:
Choose the correct option: “I would rather you ______ the report today.”
questions.why: 'Would rather' + another subject takes the past form. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: He gave me a piece of advice.
questions.why: 'Advice' is uncountable; it has no plural. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Identify the figure of speech: “He is as brave as a lion.”
questions.why: A comparison using 'as' or 'like'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “By next month, she ____ here for ten years.”
questions.why: 'By' + future time takes the future perfect. GPSC CBRT, May 2026.

questions.q: Identify the error: “Scarcely had the lecture ended than the students left the hall.”
questions.why: 'Scarcely/Hardly' pairs with 'when', not 'than'. Like GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

questions.q: Which of the following is a simple sentence?
opts: Being ill, he stayed at home.
Though he was ill, he came.
He stayed at home because he was ill.
questions.why: It has one finite verb and one clause; the others are complex or compound. GPSC-style practice item.
